flags.message: gemini-baseline's prediction.json carries created_at 2026-09-17T21:46:06Z, identical to the run id's timestamp, while its retrieval log's first call is at 23:01:25Z and its last at 23:02:51Z; the stamp appears copied from the run id rather than taken at write time. Grading is unaffected (the cell is forward and every call predates the 2026-10-05 denial), but the created_at field on that cell does not record when the prediction was written.
